examples.title: 0827 · Spoon
examples.description: RGB-only hand–object reconstruction of a slotted spoon interaction.

baselines.label: 20260928-2400s
baselines.summary: A 2400-second ASTRA reconstruction run with four exported review iterations.

3.conclusion: The initial proposal was rejected. FoundationPose drifted onto the keyboard after frame 300, while a mesh-basis mismatch and hallucinated bowl prongs produced a mean silhouette IoU of 0.056.

5.conclusion: The repaired geometry and trajectory fixed the global failure and raised mean silhouette IoU to 0.647. Ambiguous axial rotation and contact-depth intervals still required temporal refinement.

8.conclusion: Object rotation became continuous with a 5.84° maximum step, but averaging independent hand-depth choices crossed high-penetration states around frames 379 and 652–667. This contact regression was rejected.

9.conclusion: Temporal DP preserved low-penetration contact branches without averaging through the hand. The complete reconstruction was accepted with mean silhouette IoU 0.618 and a sampled maximum penetration estimate of 9.05 mm; known thin-bowl roll errors remain disclosed.

baselines.label: no harness
baselines.summary: Standalone reconstruction without the ASTRA harness, shown at three complete review stages.

1.change: First complete standalone review before correcting animation key timing.
1.conclusion: Full-scene validation found accumulated absolute-key timing error, producing up to 1.06 mm of hand interpolation discrepancy. The scene was rebuilt with explicit per-frame evaluation times.

2.change: Complete review after key-time repair but before the final object-topology correction.
2.conclusion: The full-resolution preview exposed unintended holes around the three spoon slots. The unconstrained triangulation was replaced with a watertight constrained mesh.

3.change: Final standalone scene after key-time and watertight-topology repairs.
3.conclusion: Accepted standalone reconstruction: 1200 frames at 60 fps, watertight slotted-spoon geometry, mean filled silhouette IoU 0.730, and full review validation passed.
